notes: There was no TestCase, no assertions, no runner, no red or green - so the git journey shipped at 5.151.0 had no verification half at all: you could commit and push packages nobody had ever run. - TestCase is a KERNEL class: every image has it without loading anything, and the kernel never travels, so no package can carry a divergent framework whose green disagrees with everyone else's. Subclassing is ordinary; redefining refuses. - Protocol: setUp, tearDown, assert:, deny:, assert:description:, deny:description:, assert:equals:, fail:, shouldRaise:. - THREE OUTCOMES KEPT APART, classified by a
